profiles.name: gui
profiles.notes: Visual check. Everything this mod is judged on is graphical or behavioural: asset bundle, icon atlas, drone AI, sound. A missing bundle asset does NOT log - CloneModel silently falls back to leather.fbx - so only a look catches it.
